Simon — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. We can move fast on this; a few operational guardrails we typically put in place for PO-anchored acceptance + extended terms: 

- Standard: Net45 from invoice date.
- Conditional Net60: available if we have an on-file payment assurance (e.g., SBLC or a 25% retainer) and a temporary credit cap approved by Finance.
- PO-anchored acceptance window: we can accept your PO as the trigger but require staged invoice acceptance (invoice generated at milestone dates; each invoice has a 30-day acceptance window from the invoice event). This prevents large single-shot disputes and lets us keep KV/cache & routing in sync for the pilot.

I've attached a proposed staged invoice schedule (example split: 40/30/30 tied to milestone receipts) and a draft amendment template to capture the terms. If you can confirm VAT entity details (you mentioned Ireland), we'll route EU invoices to our EU billing entity to avoid double VAT.

Attachments: redwood-staged-invoice-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps I propose: 
1) Confirm whether ClearPath can do either a 25% retainer or provide an SBLC for the pilot.
2) Confirm VAT entity and billing contact for Ireland.
3) If acceptable, we’ll route the temporary credit-exception to Finance for quick approval and send a DocuSign amendment.

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if useful.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
